route_meta.visa_type: Ethiopia Tourist e-Visa (30 / 90 Days Single or Multiple Entry)
route_meta.official_channel: Main Department for Immigration and Nationality Affairs / Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS) Ethiopia (evisa.gov.et)

processing_meta.validity_period: 30 Days or 90 Days from Intended Arrival Date
processing_meta.allowed_stay: Up to 30 Days (Single Entry) or up to 90 Days (Single/Multiple Entry)
processing_meta.entry_type: Single / Multiple Entry (Strictly valid via Addis Ababa Bole International Airport - ADD only)

how_to_apply_steps: 1️⃣ Visit the official Ethiopian Government portal: https://www.evisa.gov.et.
2️⃣ Select 'Tourist Visa' and choose your desired validity (30-Day Single Entry or 90-Day Single/Multiple Entry).
3️⃣ Fill in personal, passport, and travel details and upload digital scans of your passport bio-page and photo.
4️⃣ Pay the official visa fee (82 USD for 30-Day or 102 USD for 90-Day) securely online using credit/debit card.
5️⃣ Receive official electronic visa approval PDF via email within 24 to 72 hours.
6️⃣ Print the eVisa confirmation letter and present it alongside your passport and Yellow Fever Certificate at Addis Ababa Bole Airport immigration.

documents_checklist.name: Valid Passport (Digital Bio-Page Scan)
documents_checklist.requirement: Clear color scan of passport bio-data page valid for at least 6 months from the intended date of arrival in Ethiopia.

documents_checklist.name: Recent Digital Passport-Size Photograph
documents_checklist.requirement: Clear color photograph with white background taken within the last 6 months (JPEG or PNG format).

documents_checklist.name: Confirmed Return Flight Ticket
documents_checklist.requirement: Confirmed onward or return airline booking departing from Addis Ababa Bole International Airport (ADD).

documents_checklist.name: Hotel Booking or Host Address
documents_checklist.requirement: Confirmed hotel reservation voucher or full residential address and telephone number of your host in Ethiopia.

documents_checklist.name: Yellow Fever Vaccination Certificate
documents_checklist.requirement: International Certificate of Vaccination (ICVP) for Yellow Fever (mandatory for entry health clearance at Addis Ababa airport).

consular_directives.financial_sufficiency: Basic border verification of approximately 50 USD per day of stay in international cards or cash. No 3-year ITR, stamped bank statements, or pay slips required for online tourist eVisa.
consular_directives.port_of_entry_rule: Tourist eVisa holders are strictly authorized to enter Ethiopia through Addis Ababa Bole International Airport (ADD). Land border crossings do not process tourist eVisas on arrival.
